about.closing:
Ikiwa wewe ni mwenye udadisi.
Ikiwa wewe ni mwenye kufikiria.
Ikiwa wewe tayari kupunguza kasi na kuangalia karibu zaidi —
tayari unahusika hapa.
about.productVisualAlt: An Explorer profile connecting places, books, and ideas worth sharing.

section1.line3: Kwa kuchagua kusonga kwa uangalifu, si kwa haraka.
section1.line4:
Tunaishi kwa muda mfupi kwenye sayari ya zamani —
kuongeza alama chache za makusudi kwenye hadithi
iliyoanza muda mrefu kabla yetu
na itaendelea muda mrefu baada ya kuondoka kwetu.
section1.title: TUNAAMINI NINI

section2.line3:
Huishi katika kupunguza kasi, kuzingatia,
na kuheshimu kila eneo tunalopiga hatua —
barabara, njia ya mlima, meza ya kahawa,
au wakati ulioshirikiwa na mtu mpya.
section2.title: TUNAONAJE UCHUNGUZI

section3.item2: Maeneo, safari, sauti na hadithi zenye thamani ya kukumbuka
section3.item3: Jumuiya zilizojengwa juu ya watu — si juu ya vipimo vya umaarufu
section3.title: TUNAJENGA NINI

section4.line3:
Ni mawazo ya pamoja —
uelewa wa kimya wa jinsi tunavyosonga ulimwenguni.
section4.title: KUWA MWANACHAMA

fallbackItems.Question: Ninaweza kuongeza nini kwenye ukurasa wangu wa Explorer?

fallbackItems.Answer: Ndiyo. Ukurasa wako wa Explorer unaweza kushirikiwa kama kiungo au QR kwa wasifu, ujumbe, majedwali, kadi na miongozo iliyochapishwa.

fallbackItems.Question: Je, ninaweza kusasisha mapendekezo yangu baadaye?

fallbackItems.Answer: Ndiyo. Ukurasa unaweza kuwasiliana ahadi ya bure kwa uwazi bila lugha nzito ya malipo.

localTunes.body:
Uchunguzi sio wa kuona tu. Sauti hubeba kumbukumbu, muktadha na hisia.

Tunes inakuruhusu kukusanya na kushiriki sauti za maeneo, safari na hali — iwe ni muziki uliogunduliwa njiani au sauti zinazofafanua eneo kwako.

Imeunganishwa kwa urahisi na wasifu wako wa Explorer.
localTunes.closingStatement: Tunes ni bure kuchunguza, na kwa vipengele vilivyolipwa unaweza kuboresha baadaye.

items.name: Priya Sharma
items.quote: wagunduzi walibadilisha jinsi ninavyoshiriki maarifa yangu ya kusafiri. Wafuasi wangu wanapenda kupata ufikiaji wa papo hapo kwa mapendekezo yangu yaliyoratibiwa!

items.name: Raj Patel
items.quote: Wageni wangu wanapenda kabisa msimbo wa QR uliobinafsishwa katika vifaa vyao vya kukaribisha. Imekuwa mguso wangu wa saini!

items.name: Yuki Tanaka
items.quote: Tunashiriki wagunduzi wetu na wateja ili kupendekeza maeneo mengine ya karibu. Imeunda miunganisho ya ajabu ya jamii.

items.name: Maria Silva
items.quote: wagunduzi hunisaidia kupanua ujuzi wangu zaidi ya saa za ziara. Wateja wanaweza kufikia mapendekezo yangu wakati wowote!

items.name: James Wilson
items.quote: Kama mshawishi wa usafiri, wagunduzi hurahisisha sana kushiriki maeneo ninayopenda na hadhira yangu. Kipengele cha nambari ya QR ni nzuri!

items.name: Sophie Martin
items.quote: Ninatumia wagunduzi kuunda safari za kutembea kwa wateja wangu. Wanaweza kuchanganua QR na kuchunguza kwa mwendo wao wenyewe!

cta.title: Make a home for what you would pass on.

hero.description: Whether the point of view is personal, creative, or shared by a brand, explorers gives it a thoughtful home.
hero.title: Different perspectives. One place to share them.
hero.visualAlt: Three perspectives connected through a place, an Explorer profile, and a storefront.

journey.description: The shape changes with the person behind it. The rhythm stays simple.

collect.description: Bring together what you genuinely recommend across the parts of life that matter to you.
collect.title: Collect

shape.description: Organize it with enough context for someone else to understand why it belongs.
shape.title: Shape

share.description: Offer one living link or QR that people can save, scan, and return to.
share.title: Share

journey.title: Three perspectives. One way of sharing with care.

brands.description: Curate the places, products, guides, and ideas that express what your organization genuinely values.
brands.label: Brands
points: Build collections with a clear and human perspective.
Connect locations, products, and useful context.
Give people something thoughtful to save and revisit.
brands.title: Turn your point of view into an experience people can enter.

creators.description: Turn the recommendations scattered across posts, videos, conversations, and notes into something people can return to.
creators.label: Creators
points: Create a durable home for your point of view.
Organize recommendations around stories and themes.
Share through one link or QR wherever people find you.
creators.title: Give your audience more than a feed.

personal.description: Keep the places, books, films, tools, people, and small discoveries you return to in one living collection.
personal.label: Personal
points: Bring different kinds of recommendations together.
Add the context that makes each choice yours.
Share one page that can keep evolving with you.
personal.title: A home for the things that shape your world.

seo.description: See how people, creators, and brands can collect what they value, shape it with context, and share it through one thoughtful Explorer page.
